title: Python phantom drivers fire on shared connect callName
description: Scanner emits asset:aiosqlite, asset:asyncpg, and asset:pymysql on python-basic/app.py when only psycopg2 is imported. Those drivers share 'connect' as a callName; psycopg2.connect triggers all of them. Reproduce: scanFixtureComponents('python-basic') shows three phantom database assets at app.py:1-1.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Fixed: python detector now requires importModules to be present before emitting a database_connection. Shared callNames no longer cross-fire. Regression test added. Component precision improved 0.57 to 0.60.
